name: PURGATORIO [DEMO 2]
desc:

! THIS IS AN EARLY DEMO VERSION OF THE GAME. THERE IS ONLY CONTENT FROM GRADES 9 - 7 / CANARD - URBAN LEGEND !


PURGATORIO is an action RPG inspired by and set in an fan-original version of the Project Moon universe. Fufill your duties as the "Fixer" in the dystopian urban setting of "The City".

For additional gameplay information, check the in-game Fixer Notes.

Supports Console and Mobile play

Thumbnail and Banner by mynamelevilol (art3491)

PURGATORIO uses assets from Limbus Company, Library of Ruina, and Lobotomy Corporation. PURGATORIO only claims ownership of this game and not the assets made by the respective creators.

All music used is NOT PURGATORIO ORIGINAL and is credited in the "Settings" menu whenever used. If you enjoy the music used, please support the original creators!
